div.p: Lynch Alley was located in Post Office Place. In 1860, Lynch Alley was home to a saddler and leather seller. By 1891, the alley was dominated by Robertson & Moffatt, who had their stores and showroom located there. The Rising Sun Hotel was also listed in the alley in 1891.
